posts.body: In my game, enemies are map sprites (events) that trigger a battle once interacted with. What I'm trying to do is make it so that, when an enemy touches you from behind, it triggers a surprise attack. I'm using Galv event start types, but it doesn't have a notetag for whether you're facing the event or not.
